description: Search 490+ indexed MCP and HTTP 402 (x402) tools by capability keyword and return ranked endpoints with pricing, trust scores, and SLA tiers. WHEN TO USE: Call first to discover which native slug or external endpoint matches your task before calling execute_marketplace_tool. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use to execute a tool directly (use execute_marketplace_tool or execute_workflow_bundle). PARAMETER INTERACTIONS: Pass capability keywords or a domain in query; omit agent_id and tx_hash (this discovery tool is always free and never consumes a free trial call). Example: search_x402_mcp_marketplace(query='example')

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier or prepaid agd_pass_ session key. Omit during your 5 free trial calls to use an ID automatically derived from your client IP, or pass your agd_pass_ key after topping up.

query.description: Capability keywords, category name, or endpoint URL to search across the 490+ tool catalog.

tx_hash.description: Optional on-chain Base Mainnet (0x...) or Solana SPL USDC transaction hash. Omit unless settling an individual call directly on-chain instead of using an agd_pass_ key in agent_id.

name: search_x402_mcp_marketplace

roi_proof.description: Token compression and cost-savings verification metrics.
